raw:
@q query
  select ?p
  where all
    match
      relation "live in"
      role subject ?p
      role location "Buzău"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  except ?p "Priya"

@q2 query
  mode count
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "be postponed"
    role subject "the charity run"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "have an allergy to"
    role subject "Wei Liu"
    role object "lactose"
    polarity negated
  end

@q4 query
  where match
    relation "live in"
    role subject "Megan"
    role location "Plovdiv"
    role time "2019"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q5 query
  select ?how
  where match
    relation "commute by"
    role subject "Thomas"
    role instrument ?how
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q6 query
  select ?d
  measure duration
  where match
    relation "work on"
    role subject "Viorica"
    role object "the analysis pipeline"
    role time ?d
    polarity affirmed
  end
